topIssues.title: Update OP Mainnet Node Snapshot page
topIssues.author: sbvegan
topIssues.body:
## Description
Update the OP Mainnet node snapshot documentation so it lives in the correct OP Mainnet section and reflects current snapshot availability for op-reth.

Current page:
- https://docs.optimism.io/node-operators/guides/management/snapshots

## Acceptance criteria
- The snapshot documentation is moved under the **OP Mainnet** section (information architecture updated appropriately)
- Redirects are updated so existing links to the current URL continue to work (redirect list updated)
- The page includes up-to-date information about the new **reth snapshots** hosted at **https://datadirs.optimism.io**
- **op-reth** guidance is reflected (which snapshot to use + any relevant caveats/steps)
- Any internal references to the old location are updated to the new location

## User stories
- As an OP Mainnet node operator running op-reth, I want clear snapshot guidance so I can bootstrap quickly and correctly.

## Resources and support
- Existing docs page: https://docs.optimism.io/node-operators/guides/management/snapshots
- Snapshot hosting: https://datadirs.optimism.io

## Action items
- Decide the new target location under OP Mainnet and move the page
- Add/confirm redirects from the old path to the new path
- Add a section for reth snapshots (datadirs.optimism.io) and op-reth-specific instructions
- Update any links in related node operator docs that point to the old page

topPRs.title: This PR updates the bridge tutorial content and structure.
topPRs.author: opfocus
topPRs.body:
## Summary

This PR updates the bridge tutorial content and structure.

---

## 1. Tutorial Theme Update

**Previous title:**

> Bridging ETH to OP Mainnet with Viem

**Updated focus:**

The tutorial now introduces **Deposited Transactions** and **Withdrawals**, and explains how to process these cross-domain transactions using Viem.

---

## Rationale

1. **Mismatch between title and implementation**

   Although the original tutorial was framed as “bridging ETH”, the example implementation did **not** use the `StandardBridge`.  
   Instead, it directly interacted with:

   - `L2ToL1MessagePasser`
   - `OptimismPortalProxy`

   In practice, most bridge UIs and production flows rely on the **StandardBridge**, so the tutorial approach was not representative of common ETH bridging workflows.

2. **Lower impact of removing ETH bridge focus**

   Bridging ETH is simpler compared to bridging ERC-20 tokens.  
   Adjusting the tutorial focus has minimal impact on overall learning coverage.

3. **Highlighting foundational protocol concepts**

   **Deposited Transactions** and **Withdrawals** are more fundamental than:

   - Standard Bridge
   - Cross-Domain Messengers

   They operate at a lower protocol level and provide a more general mechanism for cross-domain execution.

4. **Sequencer bypass use case**

   Deposited transactions enable EOAs to interact with L2 contracts even when the Sequencer is down.  
   This tutorial now serves as a concrete example of:

   - [Bypassing the sequencer](./op-stack/protocol/outages#bypassing-the-sequencer)

---

## 2. Tutorial Order Adjustment

Tutorials related to **Supersim** have been moved to appear **after** the standard tutorials to improve learning flow and conceptual progression.

---

## Testing

### Submitting Arbitrary L2 Transactions from L1

Verified via the following transactions:

- **L1 Transaction**  
  https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xa16603a96a236b12ac97f2c025cf25a3f5d1a68d4162e5f021dfe7e934a8d157

- **L2 Transaction**  
  https://sepolia-optimism.etherscan.io/tx/0x879c9bd7e4f25769dbcabbe6e60aa8c9a3ea9a6d9587dd1223ffa067ef225a88

---

## References

- Unichain Docs:  
  [Submitting Transactions from L1](https://docs.unichain.org/docs/technical-information/submitting-transactions-from-l1)

- OP Stack Specification:  
  [Deposited transactions](https://specs.optimism.io/protocol/deposits.html)  
  [Withdrawals](https://specs.optimism.io/protocol/withdrawals.html)

- Viem OP Stack Docs:  
  [Deposits Guide](https://viem.sh/op-stack/guides/deposits)
